diagnosis_denominator: only eligible base tasks that fail or are insufficient under the frozen base budget

partition_target.rule: actual eligible task ids and source-family groups must be frozen before protected runs; replication may not share a source family with development or primary
partition_target.shortfall: CANNOT_CHECK rather than padding or post-outcome reassignment

INFORMATION.rule: expose only a missing benchmark-provided source/tool/data item; model, representation and compute remain frozen

ACCESSIBILITY.rule: preserve semantic information bytes; change only parsing/structure/representation/access path

COMPUTATION.rule: same information and representation; use the separately frozen increased reasoning/tool-call budget

RECONSTRUCTION.rule: same information and compute ceiling; allow exactly the registered ORION-11 replan/reformulation/reopen operation

causal_gold.rule: among successful allowed interventions, choose the intervention with the lexicographically smallest frozen cost vector

leakage_contract.diagnosis_seal: candidate diagnostic features, model identity and selected action must be hashed before any protected intervention outcome is revealed
leakage_contract.common_visible_packet: candidate and all non-oracle routers receive the same base-failure visible packet
leakage_contract.oracle: intervention oracle is analysis only and cannot be a candidate or training label outside development

required_metrics: final task success after selected intervention
diagnosis accuracy only on identifiable cases
negative_result_policy: Do not redefine cause classes, intervention costs, denominator, or tie rule after protected outcomes. A null, harmful, heterogeneous, leakage-invalid or CANNOT_CHECK result is retained.
